resume: The Master Collector Program will bring exciting benefits to every VeVe Collector.
texte:
VeVe Master Collector Program v0.2

The Master Collector Program will bring exciting benefits to every VeVe Collector.

VeVeFollow

Nov 19 · 11 min read

The Master Collector Program (MCP) is a new loyalty program available to all users designed to reward active VeVe Collectors. Through the MCP, Collectors can level up by being an active VeVe Collector, completing objectives, all while gaining benefits and rewards in a quest to reach the highest level of Master Collector.

Version History
A Summary of the changes from MCP v0.1 to v0.2 can be seen here.

PLEASE NOTE — This is a work-in-progress. The information below is the second revision of the various elements of the Master Collector Program. Details are subject to change based on development and feedback.
In this article, a “Collectible” refers to all items that can be purchased in the VeVe Store, e.g. 3D collectibles and digital comics.
There will be measures in place to prevent users from exploiting, abusing or otherwise gaming the system, so don’t make any rash decisions about your collections or purchasing activity based on this article.
If you have questions and/or suggestions about any of the below, please fill out our feedback form HERE.

Summary:
All VeVe app users are automatically enrolled in the MCP
Points will be awarded retroactively to all active VeVe users
All new VeVe Collectors are entered into the MCP, starting at Level 0
Collectors level up by earning Points from in-app activity
Collectors can earn one-off Points and/or daily recurring Points
Once the required Points are earned, the Collector will proceed to the next Level.
Collectors can spend earned Points on various features and products within VeVe. Spending Points does not affect your Level or Rank.
Collectors also will earn a Rank based on their Level and Points earned.
A Collector’s Rank position is determined by their activity relative to other Collectors

Level Points
In order to level up, a Collector must earn Points. Points are awarded to Collectors for in-app activity. For example, Points can be earned for one-off actions, such as purchasing a collectible and/or earned daily by owning collectibles or holding completed Sets. Once earned, Points can be spent on various in-app items and are non-transferable. Points can be earned from the following activities…
One-off Points
+100 Points when completing new user onboarding
+100 Points Received when completing a Set
+25 Points when purchasing collectibles in the Store
+15 Points when purchasing collectibles in the Market
+Variable amount when earning an Achievement Badge depending on Achievement type
Daily Recurring Points
Collectors can earn daily recurring Points based on their collection and in-app activity.
Collectibles Points:
+1 Point is given for each Collectible owned.
If duplicate Collectibles are held, these will be subject to diminishing Points:
- 2nd Collectible: 0.75 Points
- 3rd Collectible: 0.35 Points
- 4 Collectibles or more: 0.10 Points
Collectible Bonus Points:
Collectibles of specific rarities and/or mints will receive bonus Points.
Rarity Bonus Points:
+ 0.25 Points: Rare
+ 0.50 Points: Ultra Rare
+ 5.00 Points: Secret Rare
Low Edition Bonus:
+ 0.5 Points: Collectibles with a sub #300 mint
Collectible Set Points:
As Sets offer a varying number of collectibles, the points earned are based on the number of Collectibles within the Set:
+ 5.0 Points: 5 Collectibles or more
+ 4.0 Points: 4 Collectibles
+ 3.0 Points: 3 Collectibles
+ 2.0 Points: 2 Collectibles
+ 1.0 Points: 1 Collectible
Duplicate Set Points:
If you own one or more of the same Set, the additional Sets are subject to a reduced amount of Points vs. unique Sets.
+ 2nd set: 30% Points vs. unique Sets 
+ 3rd set: 20% Points vs. unique Sets
+ 4th set and on: 10% Points vs. unique Sets
For Example, if you own two (2) Superman collectible Sets, you would get 1.45 Points daily (1 Superman = 1.0 Points, 2nd Superman = .45 Points, etc.).

Comics: Daily Points
Daily Comic Points are based on the rarity of the Comic — for example, 0.25 Points for a Common up to 6 points for a Secret Rare. Daily Comic Points are earned as follows:
+ Common 0.25 points
+ Uncommon 0.50 points
+ Rare 2.00 points
+ Ultra Rare 3.00 points
+ Secret Rare 6.00 points
Duplicate Comics
If duplicate Comics are held, these will be subject to diminishing Points:
+ 2nd 50% of the points
+ 3rd 25% of the points
+ 4th + 10% of the points
Comics: Low Mint Bonus
+ 50% Points earned for the 5% lowest mint Comic available to the public (excludes any Comics retained by VeVe)

In-app activity:
- 1 Point is received for all in-app activity actions
- In-app activities will have a maximum limit of 25 Points per day
- In-app activity includes daily logins, sharing, commenting, liking, Market listings, etc. Additional activities will be added in the future.

Earning Points:
- Points are earned on activities/transactions that take place within VeVe
- Recurring Points stop accruing after 14 days of inactivity
- Points have a shelf life and must be spent within 6 months of earning (there will be an indication in the app on the amount of Points needed to be spent before a certain date). Points which are closest to expiring will be used first
- Points are calculated and applied once per 24hr period at a set time each day
- Points have 2 decimal places
- Earned points may change during certain periods — e.g. Double Point Bonus Days
Retroactive Points:
When the MCP is officially launched, level Points will be calculated from the time a Collector’s VeVe account was created. The number of Points received will only be calculated based on the number of Collectibles and Sets the Collector owns in that time. Collectors will also receive One-Off Points for Store Purchases, Market Purchases, and Completed Sets.
Point Limitations:
Various measures will be in place to prevent users from exploiting, abusing, or otherwise gaming the system. Here are some examples:
Sets: Points for completing a set can only be earned once per set, e.g. a user cannot complete a Set, sell a collectible from the Set, and then buy it back to complete the Set again.
Market: Points for purchasing are applied once per collectible, e.g. you can’t purchase the same low-cost collectible over and over to gain Points. 
Additionally, Market Purchase Points are earned for the first 5 collectible Market purchases daily, e.g. you can’t spend the day buying different low-cost collectibles to infinitely gain points.

Levels, Ranks, Badges
The Master Collector Program consists of Levels and Ranks. Levels start at Level 0 (new user) and increase as the Collector earns Points. Each VeVe Collector also has a Rank, and a Collector’s Rank position is determined by their activity relative to other Collectors. For example, the top percentile of Collectors will likely have a high Level and the Rank of Master Collector.
Levels
To level up, the Collector must earn the required amount of Points to go from one level to the next. Each Level has a required amount of Points, and when enough Points are earned, the Collector will level up. Leveling is exponential and more Points are required as the Levels get higher.
Each Collector’s Level is displayed on their Profile page within an MCP badge, and the Collector Level shows wherever their Profile is visible, such as on their Profile page, Feed posts, or Market listings.
As Collectors reach specific milestone Levels, they will gain access to items and new or expanded features within VeVe. For example, Milestone 3D Level badges (e.g. one for every 10 levels, displayable in Showrooms), expanded profile, a free number of Premium Market Listings (more below), expanded AR features, Drop Raffle access (more below), accessories, exclusive content, level-based chat rooms, and more.
Rank
Along with Levels, the MCP consists of 23 Ranks. The Collector’s Rank is based on their position relative to other VeVe Collectors. The lowest Rank is Bronze I and the highest Rank is Master Collector. The 23 ranks are divided based on percentages. For example, the highest Rank, Master Collector, is reserved for the top percentile of Collectors.
Unlike Levels, Ranks are not static or kept permanently. As a Collector, your Rank position can move up or down based on your performance relative to other Collectors. For example, you might be a mid-tier Rank, and if your Rank was to increase, you may replace a Collector in a higher Rank, who would move down a Rank position.
Badges
Various activities within VeVe will reward collectors with Achievement Badges — for example, completing a Set. Badges are displayed on the Collector’s public Profile and some Badges can be added to your Showrooms. When a new Badge is earned, the Collector will receive Points.

Drop Raffle
The MCP Drop Raffle gives Collectors a greater chance to obtain a specific collectible in an upcoming drop. A percentage of editions, of each rarity, in a drop will be made available for the raffle. Users can participate in the Drop Raffle by using their Points to purchase a Drop Raffle ticket. The more tickets a Collector has relative to other Drop Raffle participants, the greater the chance of success.
The Collector can buy as many raffle tickets as their Points will allow. When the Drop Raffle closes, winners will be randomly selected from the pool of ticket holders. Collectors who are unsuccessful in the Drop Raffle will get 90% of their Points returned.
How It Works:
At a set time before a drop, the MCP Drop Raffle will open to those Collectors above the required MCP level. The Collector can choose which collectible and rarity they want to buy Drop Raffle tickets for. The number of Collectors competing for a collectible will be shown, however, the number of Drop Raffle tickets will not be known.
The MCP Drop Raffle will close a short time before a drop and successful Collectors will be notified. The winners must claim the collectible before the drop takes place. If a collectible is not claimed before the drop, it is returned to the public drop pool. When a winning collectible is claimed, the Collector is prompted to make the payment (in Gems), and the collectible will be delivered to their collection post-drop.

Accessories
Within the Store, various Accessories will be made available for purchase using Points. Accessories that can be purchased with Points will (generally) be non-licensed, high-edition items, allowing Collectors to trick out their Showrooms.

Premium Market Listings
Premium Market Listings allow for greater exposure when selling items in the VeVe Market. Collectors can spend Points for Premium Market Listings, which will display before non-Premium Listings for any given collectible. To prevent the Market from being overrun with Premium Listings, only a select number of Premium Listings will be available for any one collectible. Premium Listings will be featured on the Market > Landing screen as well as when viewing specific collectibles.

MCP Pro
MCP Pro is designed for those collectors who want to take their collecting to the next level. With MCP Pro, Collectors can gain exclusive features within VeVe to grow their collection and access additional Pro-only features. Collectors in the top six Ranks will automatically gain access to MCP Pro at no cost, whereas all other Collectors who opt-in will be charged a monthly subscription (pricing to be shared at a later date). The subscription will be accessible only above a specific Level.
Features:
- Small percentage bonus on all Points earned
- Exclusive MCP Pro Badges to display in Showrooms
- Premium User Profile Badge
- Display rarity and edition # next to Collectibles in Showrooms and AR
- Auto-bid feature for Market Auctions
- Access to exclusive content (Accessories/Collectibles)
- Burn Collectibles for Points
- And more…

Roadmap
To make the MCP available to Collectors in an expedient manner, the MCP features will be rolled out in phases, with each phase focusing on key aspects of the MCP:
Phase 1: Points, Levels, Ranks
Phase 2: Drop Raffle
Phase 3: Accessories, Premium Market Listings, Badges
Phase 4: MCP Pro

FAQ
Who has access to the MCP?
All registered users will automatically be enrolled in the MCP, starting at Level 0.
When will the MCP be available in VeVe?
Development on Phase 1 is now underway, and once complete, the following phases will go into development.
When will each phase be released? 
We will aim to release each phase as soon as possible. That said, development timelines can change due to varying factors, so we cannot give a precise release date until closer to release. Each of the phases will release when ready (e.g. #soon).
Will Points be retroactive?
Yes. Points will be calculated from the day VeVe launched, so your activity within VeVe to date will contribute to your MCP Level and Rank. The number of Points received will only be calculated based on the number of Collectibles and Sets the Collector owns in that time.
Collectibles received via transfer will not receive the one-off Points listed earlier in the article, but will also be calculated retroactively from the time you acquired them. More simply, you will get points for holding and set completion, but not for off-platform purchases.
Why is MCP Pro available to the top six Ranks?
At VeVe we support the Collectors who are the most active, so it was a no-brainer to make these features available to these Collectors.
If I held Collectibles and Sets in the past, but sold them before the MCP releases, will I still earn Points for the time I held those Sets/collectibles?
Yes, those Collectibles/Sets will still earn Points retroactively for the time you held them, even if you don’t hold them anymore once the MCP starts.
Will transferred collectibles count towards the MCP?
Collectibles received from a transfer will receive Daily Points, however as they’re not purchased from Store or Market, they will not receive the One-Off Points for Purchase (see the One-Off Points section).
Will holding unique Sets earn more Points than duplicates of the same Set?
Yes, duplicate Sets will have diminishing bonuses vs. unique Sets (see the Collectible Sets section of the article).
Do the Rarity bonuses also apply to Digital Comics, and do Digital Comics earn points otherwise?
Yes, rarity bonuses apply to Digital Comics as well as the rest of the Collectibles. However, Digital Comics do not have traditional Sets, so Set bonuses will not apply to Digital Comics.
Instead of Set bonuses, Series bonuses will apply for Digital Comics. For example, you will get bonus Points for having the full Amazing Spider-Man comic Series released to that point (see the Digital Comic Series section).
Will we be able to earn/use Points in the VeVeVerse?
Yes, Points can be earned and used within the VeVeVerse. More details will be released closer to the launch of the VeVeVerse.
What about OMI Utility?
OMI Utility will be a separate program and article, but there will be some overlap with MCP, so stay tuned for more on that soon.

PLEASE NOTE — This is a work-in-progress plan. The information below is an initial outline of the various elements in the Master Collector Program. Details are subject to change based on development and feedback. In this article, a “Collectible” refers to all items that can be purchased in the VeVe Store, e.g. 3D collectibles and digital comics.
There will be measures in place to prevent users from exploiting, abusing or otherwise gaming the system, so don’t make any rash decisions about your collections or purchasing activity based on this article.

VeVe Metadata: What You Need To Know

Info about your digital collectibles and digital comic NFTs will soon be viewable on the Immutable X blockchain explorer!

With the VeVe web app now live and available to the public, we are enabling the first phase of our metadata link with Immutable X. A range of information about your VeVe digital collectibles and digital comic NFTs will soon be viewable on the Immutable X blockchain explorer, including the collectible type, edition number, rarity and more!
What is NFT Metadata?
Blockchain networks are great at recording transactions, but they have never been optimal for data storage. This means that the token part of your non-fungible tokens (NFTs) lives on chain, but the actual asset (image files, videos, etc.) and any other information that displays what that token actually represents is typically stored off chain. This information is known as the NFT metadata, and by storing it off chain, we reduce the computational power (and therefore the costs and environmental impacts) of using the Ethereum Network.
VeVe Collectible and Digital Comic Metadata
Although VeVe utilizes Immutable X’s technology to mint NFTs, it is also a standalone platform, and up until now the only place to view metadata for VeVe NFTs was within the VeVe app. Enabling the VeVe metadata link will allow you to view VeVe collectible information on the IMX explorer, Immutascan, and any similar products that can access the IMX API.
Through the VeVe Web Wallet, users can also retrieve their OMI wallet address and search them on Immutascan to view the contents of their VeVe wallets, including the collectible types, editions, brand information, and more. This will also allow users to link a VeVe NFT token ID (viewable on the IMX blockchain explorer) to specific collectibles and comics within the platform.

Wen Metadata?
We are expecting to enable VeVe metadata in early October. Once live, VeVe Collectors will be able to see the metadata for any new drops shortly after the drop takes place.
For any collectibles or comics that were minted before metadata was enabled, there will be a lag time before this information is viewable on IMX. We are working with IMX to make this happen quickly, however, it should be expected to take 6–8 weeks before metadata for all 7.5m VeVe NFTs show on the IMX explorer.
Metadata for VeVe Artwork releases or any items claimed/redeemed with a promotional code will typically be viewable on-chain within 3–4 days of the drop/receiving the collectible, however, this is also expected to be available much quicker in the coming months.
This is the first stage of the VeVe metadata link, and we will continue to provide access to more data points in future updates. In the meantime, you can access additional insights and information on third-party platforms.
We look forward to seeing the tools and utilities the Fam creates using this information!

resume: Our first IRL event has come to a close, and we truly couldn’t be more humbled, happy, and downright thankful to everyone who came out!
texte:
DesignerCon Wrap-Up

VeVe.Follow

Nov 21 · 5 min read

Our first ‘in real life’ event has come to a close, and we truly couldn’t be more humbled, happy, and downright thankful to everyone who contributed to the weekend's success. Alex, Rhys, Trevor, and Noah represented VeVe, while the Fam took over the booth to celebrate drop shows, live stream community conversations, and lend a hand wherever and whenever it was needed, and for that, we are truly thankful 🙏

The VeVe Booth
As our first live event, we decided to keep things simple and let VeVe speak for itself. New users/attendees were able to explore the VeVe app on iPads, explore and try the AR functions, and of course, hit us with any questions along the way.
Alex’s meticulously designed AR photo booth also turned into the perfect background for a community photo op p— who are we to deny the people?!
With two display screens, we were able to showcase some of the key features of the VeVe app, show off some of the most incredible VeVe Showrooms (shout out Vaultoholics), and keep everyone informed of the weekend's drop schedule. For those keeping an eye out, we even teased an upcoming release, but you’ll have to watch the reel for that one.

Attendees also had the opportunity to inspect the illusive Rabbit Grin - the brainchild of artist Ron English - which offers VeVe Collectors a chance to nab the digital collectible and receive the absolutely stunning physical counterpart (more info #soon). The coveted VeVe lightbox was also on display, alongside the laughs and smiles of the entire VeVe Fam 🤩
Free Swag!
It wouldn’t be a DesignerCon event without oodles of swag, and thanks to the overwhelming support from the VeVe Fam and event attendees, we handed out more than 1500 VeVe/DCon-branded T-shirts over the weekend.
We were also lucky enough to hand out some special merch thanks to tokidoki. Any VeVe user who showed us a VeVe Mermicorno Series 1 collectible from their collection was able to claim a physical Mermicorno Series 2 collectible, which came in its own blind box. In addition, ALL DCon attendees carried VeVe-branded entry passes and event booklets with them throughout the event!

The #VeVeFam Meet-Up
Although we all crossed paths throughout the weekend, the first official VeVe Fam meetup took place on Saturday night, as everyone (Rhys) let their hair down and celebrated. As expected, it was a very low-key, sit-down type of event, with water and Gatorade as the beverages of choice…on Sunday morning that is!
Collectible Releases
There were 16 drops across the DCon weekend, with many serving as the first entry into the NFT space for the majority of the artists, and almost an entire weekend of Con Exclusives. The jam-packed schedule also saw the first skateboard decks hit the platform, and because these were very limited edition items, every collectible/artwork flew off the digital shelves in seconds.

It wasn’t just the digital pieces selling out though — our community of Collectors raced to secure the physical pieces as well, causing a near-instant sellout of Lincoln’s gold skate decks on the first night!
That excitement was shared directly with our artists, some of whom were still skeptical going into the weekend. And, we get it — this is still a new industry, but the shock of an instant sell-out was certainly enough to spark new conversations. Coupled with the energy and passion from the VeVe Fam, the success of the drops truly helped to cement digital collectible NFTs as a new form of expression and creativity for artists, and our place as an ongoing partner at DesignerCon. Of course, it also opened conversations with a range of new artists, but you’ll have to stay tuned for more info on that front!
The energy surrounding each drop at the event was palpable, as the VeVe Fam paused live streams and conversations and came together to assemble the first-ever ‘drop circles’ before spamming that Buy button in the hopes of acquiring their favorite pieces. It was the perfect drawcard for those who were yet to discover VeVe, and an incredible opportunity to share the experience in person - so to everyone who came out to support and celebrate with us, we want to share a huge thank you with you all!

In Case You Missed It
It wouldn’t be a VeVe meetup without at least a few live streams and AMAs. Whether it was a live drop show on our Discord with Granola, Eagle Eyes, and Jeomite, the Voices of VeVe streams with Wendy, an AMA with Taps, Noah, and Rhys, or the smiling face of Randy Chavez giving complete event tours, there was truly no shortage of information and content to enjoy.
Not only was it an incredible way to showcase the event, but it also served to bring the entire Fam one step closer together, and introduce DesignerCon to everyone who couldn’t make it (although we hope to meet even more of you at the next one!).
For everyone who came out to support, stream and meet the Fam — it was an absolute honor and pleasure to meet you all. Every single one of you contributed greatly to the success of the weekend, and we truly couldn’t be more thankful for your help, energy, and participation!
If you missed any of them you can catch up on the video streams below, and if you’ve never joined a VeVe drop show, be sure to jump into our Discord server ahead of each NFT release to chat with the fam and learn all the tips and tricks for drop success!

Payout: What You Need To Know

Details on Payout including KYC process, fees, and more…

Since the inception of VeVe, many collectors have amassed amazing collections and some have been lucky enough to on-sell their collectibles in VeVe’s secondary market for more than they paid. Now, as we begin to open access to our beta Payout feature, collectors will be able to convert their Gems into selected currencies and withdraw.
Payout Feature
Payout is a system that allows you to withdraw your Gems from your VeVe wallet, and back into your bank account in your local currency or into a cryptocurrency wallet.
Payout currently supports Bank Transfer (fiat) and the cryptocurrencies: USDT, ETH, Binance USD (all ERC20) and BTC.
In order to use this feature, you will be required to complete KYC (Know Your Customer), and be verified, before you can make any withdrawals. Our partner Wyre is the provider of the Payout service (Wyre’s user agreement)
Payout Requirements
There are a few more details to be aware of in relation to Payouts.
You may only use your personal bank account or cryptocurrency wallet for the payout.
You must have a minimum balance of 1,000 Gems to qualify for Payout.
There is a 100 Gem minimum withdrawal.
The maximum withdrawal amount (for now) is 50,000 Gems in any 7 day period.
We can’t give any guarantees about timing given the nature of the international banking system but we expect most bank transfers to arrive in around 5 business days. Cryptocurrency payouts generally occur within the standard block time
Wyre is providing the Payout service. Wyre will conduct their own compliance checks (comparable to any other payment provider) before approving a payout.
Get Verified to Access Payout
In order to access Payout you must be Verified, or in other word pass KYC or ‘Know-Your-Customer’ regulations. Getting verified requires you to provide identification documents in order to complete a financial transaction. Processing a Payout transaction on VeVe is no different, and you will be required to complete this process before you can withdraw.
Completing VeVe Verification is a relatively straightforward process and more in-depth details can be found here: KYC — What You Need To Know.
How to Use the Payout Feature
After being successfully verified, Collectors can access the payout feature on the VeVe web app, which is found on Profile > Settings > Payout
1. Enter Payout Amount

You must have a minimum Gem balance of 1,000 Gems to payout
Enter the amount of Gems you wish to payout — Please note the minimum is 100 Gems
2. Select Payout Method

Choose the payout method
Bank Transfer
Cryptocurrency — BTC, ETH , USDT, Binance USD
Agree to the payout terms and conditions
Click “Next”
2a. Payout Method: Bank Transfer

The first time you payout to a bank account you will be prompted to add the bank account details
After selecting ‘Bank Transfer’ Choose ‘Add Account’ from the adjacent dropdown menu
Once a bank account has been added it will be available for future payouts
Add Bank Account

Choose your currency — Note: If your local currency is not shown, choose USD and this will be converted to your local currency
The Beneficiary Name will default to the name you entered when getting Verified
Enter all bank account details: Account number, Routing number (US only), BIC / SWIFT, Bank Name, Bank Country
Press “Add Account”
Review Bank Payout

You will have 5 minutes to complete the payout
Review all detail of the payout to ensure the detail are correct — If not, click the edit icon (pencil) to update the details
Click “Withdraw”
2b. Payout Method: Cryptocurrency

Choose your preferred cryptocurrency
Enter applicable cryptocurrency wallet address (e.g. BTC)
Agree to the payout terms and conditions
Click “Next”
Review Cryptocurrency Payout

You will have 5 minutes to complete the payout
Review all details of the payout to ensure the detail are correct — Ensure the entered address is valid; Cryptocurrency payments cannot be reversed
Click “Withdraw”
Payout Fees
A 10% fee will be applied to any Payout transaction. In addition, the following Fees may apply.
For payouts in fiat (e.g. USD):
For U.S. users, where possible, payment will be sent by ACH and a USD$1 ACH transfer fee applies (Wyre’s Non-Operational ACH US States are not eligible for ACH payments)
U.S. users not eligible for ACH payment or users outside of the US, payout will be by wire transfer and a $15 USD wire transfer fee applies.

Q: Why is Payout not available in my country?
A: There are some restrictions on some countries due to international regulations and sanctions. Q: Am I eligible for ACH payments?
A: ACH is a payment method only available in the US and has a lower fee than a wire transfer/international bank transfer. Celebrate the season with the first chapter of the renowned Ice Sword saga! Drops in blind box format Wed, 7 Dec at 8 AM PT.

The next offering in VeVe’s digital comic line-up continues with an iconic comic from Disney — Mickey Mouse and the Ice Sword! This 103 page saga is fully readable, with five variant covers in blind box format.
Celebrate the season with the first chapter of the renowned Ice Sword saga, written by Massimo de Vita, featuring Mickey & Friends! A terrible menace is threatening the land of Argaar and only a true hero can defeat it by unlocking the secret Sword of Ice. But when a wayward wizard seeks out such a champion, he accidently gets Mickey Mouse and Goofy! However, our heroes are up for the challenge and soon they have to face royal giants, incredible dragons, and overwhelming dangers — but guess what? A slippery, sparkly, and striking rainbow awaits them!

Vintage/Main Cover
This is the very first cover of the Topolino weekly magazine that included episodes of the Ice Sword Saga. The first comic stories were released in Italy in 1982 and the great cover illustration created by Italian artist Marco Rota communicates the mood of the story perfectly thanks to the dynamic pose used for Mickey, the mysterious shape of the villain coming out of the darkness and the lighting used to drive the attention to the sword.
Gold/Trilogy Variant
After the success of Mickey Mouse and the Ice Sword, two more chapters were published and the Ice Sword became a saga! The three chapters of the series were collected for the first time in Italy in 1989 in a special volume featuring an original illustration from the main author Massimo de Vita. The new cover design felt so special that in some countries it has been printed on shining, golden paper.
Italian Variant
On this cover, of all of the main characters enclosed in the golden circle, Goofy is the star. Even though the story is called Mickey Mouse and the Ice Sword, by now readers have gathered that thanks to his unusual wisdom and natural skepticism Goofy is the real protagonist of the saga.
Blue/Platinum/New Italian Variant
Drawn by Andrea Freccero, this cover has been colored by Italian artist Mario Perrotta. This new variant cover stands out from other Ice Sword saga covers because, if we look hard enough, we can see one of the characters of the story, an elf, peeking out from behind the original group!
Ultimate Variant
This cover, drawn by Andrea Freccero and colored by Andrea Cagol, is the perfect synthesis of all elements of the fantasy adventure Mickey and Goofy go on in search of the secret of the Sword of Ice. This art piece portrays the most iconic characters of the story next to the secondary characters that Mickey and Goofy meet during their adventure. The illustrated scene is inspired by the end of the story when our heroes, after facing overwhelming dangers and incredible obstacles, finally accomplish their mission.

resume: We’re levelling the playing field and giving everyone a chance to collect from their favourite brands!
texte:
VeVe Drop Day Updates

VeVe.Follow

Jul 13 · 3 min read

In our endeavour to make VeVe Drop Days as fair as possible for our userbase, we are constantly implementing new features and security measures to ensure everyone has an equal opportunity to collect from their favourite brands. After saying goodbye to #clockgate, we’re now ready to implement the next iteration of these measures!

1. Getting Ready to ‘Buy Now’
Recently we added a countdown timer to the app so that everyone knew the exact time our new collectibles would be released. This week we are happy to report that the ‘Buy Now’ button will be visible to all users before the drop opens, and the timer has been moved to the left. This is to help prevent any lag/latency issues experienced by users with older devices or unstable internet connections.

Note: If you tap the Buy Now button before the timer reaches 0:00, you will be given an error message. With some drops decided in those crucial early seconds, you certainly don’t want to be hitting it too early!

Don’t tap the Buy Now too early or you’ll receive this message!

2. Randomised Edition Numbers
Up until now, VeVe drops have always been “first come, first served.” While this has been an effective mechanism up until now, we are always looking to find improved ways to accommodate our rapidly growing userbase. Of course, our wonderful community has become a core source of feedback and ideas, and thanks to one of those suggestions, we are now implementing randomised edition numbers!
Now, when you participate in a VeVe Drop, you will be randomly assigned a collectible edition number. This will not only help to even out your odds of getting a low mint, but also add an element of surprise to our Drop Days!
3. Prove You’re Human
The final implementation to take place in the coming update is the addition of a CAPTCHA to prove that you’re 100% human and not part robot! Using the best and latest technologies, the CAPTCHA will require you to solve a puzzle before you can confirm your purchase.
After successfully reserving a collectible, users will have 90 seconds to complete the puzzle and confirm their purchase, or their collectible will return to the pool and be made available for the next reservation - so you better have your thinking cap on for Drop Day!

Note: The default language for the CAPTCHA is English, however, you can change it to your preferred language by tapping the ‘EN’ when presented with the puzzle, so you can participate no matter which language you speak!
When Will This Be Live?
These updates are expected to roll out before this week's collectible release. When they are available, you will be prompted to update your app and will need to proceed with the update before you have access again. Stay tuned to our social channels for the latest updates!

resume: Two-factor authentication (2FA) increases the security of your VeVe account by adding an additional step of verification
texte:
VeVe: 2FA Account Security

VeVeFollow

Apr 17 · 3 min read

Why is 2FA Important?
Two-factor authentication (2FA) increases the security of your VeVe account by adding an additional step of verification before important actions can take place, such as logging in. So even if somebody guesses your password, they won’t be able to access your account with 2FA
When is 2FA needed?
Account Access
When logging in to your VeVe account — even if somebody guesses your password, they won’t be able to access your account.
Collectible Transfers
2FA is required to transfer digital collectibles from your account to another user.
Gem Transfers
2FA is required when sending Gems from your account to another user.
OMI Transfers
2FA is required when sending OMI from your account.
2FA for all VeVe Accounts
As your account security is a priority for us, 2FA is enabled for all users. For more information on how to keep your VeVe account secure, please see:
VeVe Account Security
To help you remain vigilant and protect your collectibles from nefarious operators and bad actors we want to reiterate…

medium.com

How does 2FA work?
When triggering any of the aforementioned actions, you will be prompted to enter a 6 digit code before proceeding. The code will be emailed to the email address associated with your VeVe account.
2FA Steps:
You will be presented with a pop-up box asking you to check your registered email account.
The email will contain a 6 digit code
Enter the code into the app
That’s it! Once you enter the verification code you can continue enjoying VeVe.

Troubleshooting
I didn’t get my 2FA code email — Wait a few minutes for the email to arrive. If after a few minutes you do not receive a 2FA email please check your spam folders and be sure to add no-reply@veve.me to your address book.
In the event you do not receive the email, please wait 30 seconds and tap ‘resend email’ in the VeVe app to send a new code.
Note: You must use the most recent code that you received in order to confirm and approve your transactions.
If you cannot resolve the problem with the steps above, contact VeVe Support
Google Authenticator
In the first rollout of 2FA, email confirmation is the available option
In a future update, additional 2FA options, such as Google Authenticator, will also become available.

resume: A digital and social revolution for collecting in the Modern Era
texte:
Collecting 2.0 — Digital Collectibles

A digital and social revolution for collecting in the Modern Era

VeVeFollow

Jan 17 · 5 min read

As fans and collectors, we have an intrinsic drive to covet items from our favourite fandoms. From sports teams to cars to action figures and superheroes, we love to collect and be a part of these worlds.
Every now and then, maybe once in a generation, a new schmancy advancement comes along that expands collecting into a new medium — and we are lucky enough for that to be here and now — to witness the rise of digital collectibles.
Digital collecting mirrors what we can do in the physical world of collecting, and VeVe brings the same experience (or close to it) in the digital space. Modern problems require modern solutions, and as our spaces get smaller, our world is going digital, and we become more environmentally aware, digital collectibles are one such solution.

But I love physical collectibles. I know. So do we, and we always will… In the same way that we collect figurines, statues, posters, t-shirts, bags, hats, pens, underwear, stationery, bobbleheads (you get the idea), digital offers a new and exciting collectible medium for us to explore.
Whether it’s collecting your favourite superhero or artist, acquiring rare exclusive editions, or connecting with collectors and fans from around the world, VeVe allows anyone with a (smart) phone or tablet to enter the world of digital collecting.
What Is a Digital Collectible?

Left: DC Harley Quinn Statue. Right: VeVe Digital Collectible Statue

Like a physical statue of Batman, VeVe digital collectibles are limited edition 3D sculptures, viewed through your phone or tablet.
These incredible, limited edition digital collectibles are digitally sculpted by world-renowned artists including Jim Lee, Todd MacFarlane and Scott Snyder and are now available to collect in 3D premium digital format.
Digitally Sculpted? Back in ye ole times, before th’ computator was aroun’, clay was the common medium used by sculptors to bring characters to life. Nowadays, in our digital world, artists sculpt with the same tools but in 3D software, and we see this digital handiwork everywhere in games we play and definitely the latest Michael Bay movie.
As an example, the coveted, long-running, Batman Black and White statue series from DC is now available in premium digital format allowing fans to own limited edition digital sculptures of the physical line.

The Digital Collectible Experience
Digital collectibles offer a collectible experience we are used to, just in a new form. Let’s say you are the lucky owner of a Batman Black & White #100 digital collectible. Just like the physical version, your digital collectible is limited edition, owned by you, can be sold by you, can be photographed in RL (real life), can be interacted with, shared on social, placed in (virtual) showrooms, and more.
Your Collection
At any time you can view your digital collectibles in full 3D viewing, from any angle. You can add objects and upgrades, change backgrounds, place in the real world with AR (augmented reality), take photos, videos, and share on your most ❤ social platform.
Displays and Showrooms
If you are like you us, you dream of collectible showrooms with no boundaries on size or epicness, and we can obtain this unbridled experience with VeVe digital showrooms — spaces in the digital world which you create and customise, place digital collectibles and decorate with a library of accessories to create epic 3D dioramas in the ultimate digital showroom!
Sharing is Caring
Collecting is a lot more fun when we share the experience with our fellow fans and collectors. We do so through social sharing our most prized curios, and where location allows, seeing it in person. In the digital space, however, this experience is taken to the next level letting you explore other collectors showrooms and collections, in full 3D or AR, from your own living room (or wherever you may be), and vice versa. Put some effort into your showrooms and you might even get a like and/or comment ;)
Digital Doesn’t Decay
Play with your digital collectibles an infinite number of times without fear of damage. If you own the physical version, enjoy the digital version and preserve the former in its pristine box in that dark corner of your wardrobe.
Secondary Market
A collectible wouldn’t be a collectible if you were not able to sell it, hopefully for more than you paid for it. Through the VeVe Market, buyers and sellers from around the world can instantly buy, sell or bid on each other’s listings — think of it as e-bay for digital collectibles.
Digital Ownership
So by this point, you might be asking how can I own something that is digital? It would be a reasonable question to ask as a decade ago digital ownership did not exist — a digital file could be copied, sent or deleted without ramification or attachment to an owner.
So what’s the difference now? Blockchain. A digital ledger with an immutable record of ownership of your digital asset (collectible). Blockchain also allows digital ownership to be transferred from one person to another, giving digital objects real-world tangibility.
See VeVe in Action

What Can I Collect in Digital?
Whether you love pop culture, gaming, sports, film and TV, or anime and animation, VeVe offers digital collectibles from your favourite brands including Batman, Adventure Time, Monster Hunter, NFL, DC Collectibles, Star Trek, Jurassic Park, Fast and the Furious, Back to the Future, Ultraman, Superman, and SO MUCH MORE.
VeVe offers fans and collectors three types of digital collectible:
Static: like a Batman Black & White statue
Animated: think a monster from Monser Hunter doing its death move
Interactive: controllable as in drive your DeLorean digital collectible around, in AR, like it was a radio control car.
How to Get Started With VeVe

Humberto Ramos
Humberto has been drawing comics professionally since 1993 when he started at Milestone Media, then transitioned to work on Impulse for DC Comics. In 1996, he worked for Marvel Comics and Wildstorm Productions. In 1998, he co-founded the imprint Cliffhanger with artists Joe Madureira and J. Scott Campbell and released creator-owned books Crimson and Out There.
In 2003, he worked on Peter Parker and Spectacular Spider-Man for Marvel. In 2005, released creator-owned Revelations through Dark Horse. In 2006, worked on Wolverine, New X-Men & X-Men, and Runaways v3. In 2011, he began interiors on Amazing Spider-Man starting with “BIG TIME” with Dan Slott and continuing on arcs like “Spider-Island,” “Ends of the Earth,” “Alpha” and “Dying Wish.”
Superior Spider-Man was the next leg of work at Marvel with the Spider-Man office and it allowed Humberto to join his Amazing Spider-Man creative teammates to work on some of the best content during the books 31-issue run. After that, he worked on the “Hunted’’ storyline that led him to the co-creator book, Strange Academy, which he has been working on over the past 3 years.

resume: Producing an ever-expanding hydra of entertainment collectibles, Mondo is bringing their limited edition prints and artworks to VeVe!
texte:
VeVe Welcomes Mondo

Mondo, the most iconic creators of alternative movie posters, is bringing their limited edition artworks to VeVe

VeVe.Follow

Jul 20 · 3 min read

Over the last 15 years, the alternative movie poster has emerged as a new age collectible, connecting artists, fans and collectors to artworks that re-imagine the mass-produced nature of movie posters into high-quality, limited edition prints.
Beginning as a small merchandising arm of the Alamo Drafthouse cinema, Mondo has grown to become one of the largest and most popular pop culture print companies in the world, working with a huge array of licenses and artists to create an “ever-expanding hydra of entertainment collectibles” based on pop culture past and present.
The Mondo Gallery in Austin, Texas, commissions world-class illustrators and artists to remake classic movie posters based on fan-favorite movies and TV shows, which have become incredibly sought after collectibles and pieces of memorabilia. The works are often released as hand-numbered, limited edition prints, with many of them selling for thousands in auction houses.

EXAMPLE ONLY: Mondo-produced posters for Star Wars, The Empire Strikes Back, and Return of the Jedi by artist Olly Moss

Thanks to Mondo’s pop-culture ethos, the company has brought together truly incredible artists like Becky Cloonan, Laurent Durieux, and Olly Moss (just to name a few) and commissioned works for some of the biggest brands in the world.

EXAMPLE ONLY: Mondo prints inspired by the Cyberpunk 2077 RPG game. Artwork by Phantom City Creative.

Mondo X VeVe
Although Alternative Movie Posters originated as a niche offering, Mondo’s part pop-culture part fine art creations have brought these modern works into the limelight, and their prints continue to amass popularity within the collectible world.
VeVe is incredibly excited to connect fans to the movies and memorabilia that they love by offering Mondo prints and collectible content as digital collectible NFTs to our growing user base.
“Mondo has collaborated with the top film studios in the entertainment industry and continues to provide exciting, new movie-based collectibles to fans all around the world. We are very excited to have Mondo as a partner to create top-tier digital collectible content that fans will enjoy and cherish for many years to come.”
— David Yu, CEO, VeVe

In the debut series of NFTs from Mondo, VeVe will feature 2D artworks from iconic movies such as Back to the Future and Bill & Ted’s Excellent Adventure as Con Exclusives.
We’ll release more information on future drops from Mondo as it becomes available. Happy collecting!

texte:
VeVe Launching Carbon Neutral NFTs, Announces ~7M USD Grants to Environmental Nonprofits

VeVe, which already operates using blockchain technology that is >99% more energy efficient than Ethereum, will purchase carbon credits to offset the carbon footprint caused by minting NFTs as well as grant 1 billion OMI to offset the cost of designing and producing NFTs for fundraising efforts by environmental nonprofits.

VeVe WriterFollow

Mar 18 · 3 min read

Being sustainable has always been a strong priority for VeVe and ECOMI since our founding. Our carbon neutrality pledge is a step toward making NFT digital collectibles and the digital AR metaverse part of a green, environmentally friendly future.
New Zealand based non-fungible token (NFT) digital collectible App, VeVe, today announced plans to become the first carbon neutral NFT platform, beginning with a commitment to offset 100% of the carbon footprint caused by the minting of NFTs, negating the environmental impact caused by distributed ledger technologies. Initially, VeVe will offset the carbon footprint by purchasing carbon credits equal to the amount of CO2 used in minting NFTs.
Additionally, VeVe has also announced a grant of 1 billion OMI tokens — equal to approximately $7 million USD — for environmental non-profits and charities who wish to mint and sell NFTs for fundraising and other purposes. The grant could go to offset the cost of graphic design, animation, and technological development of NFTs.
Co-Founder and COO, Dan Crothers said, “Being sustainable has always been a strong priority for VeVe and ECOMI since our founding. Our carbon neutrality pledge is a step toward making NFT digital collectibles and the digital AR metaverse part of a green, environmentally friendly future.”
GREENER BLOCKCHAIN TECHNOLOGY
Concerns about the environmental effects of blockchain technology have grown as the amount of electricity used and the carbon footprint of the Ethereum blockchain has grown exponentially. Ethereum’s blockchain, which uses the Proof-of-Work consensus, incentivizes miners to compete to validate transactions. As the price of Ethereum increases, the economic incentive to invest capital in more computational power increases, causing electricity usage and carbon footprint to spike.
VeVe currently operates on a blockchain that does not incentivize competition amongst miners. There is no incentive to increase electricity expenditure because rewards are not tied to energy consumption. As a result, minting an NFT on VeVe requires 99% less energy consumption and has a 99% lower carbon footprint compared to minting on the Ethereum blockchain.
GOING ZERO NET CARBON
While our carbon footprint is significantly lower than peer technologies, it has always been important to VeVe to achieve net zero carbon at some point. As a platform that hosts major brands, licensors, artists and more, VeVe is now able to provide these stakeholders the ability to market their NFTs as sustainable. According to NYU Stern, sales of sustainability marketed products are projected to reach $150 bn in 2021, and since 2013 have grown 5.6 x faster than conventional products.
VeVe CEO, David Yu said: “Moving from physical to digital products already cuts down on packaging, logistics and manufacturing waste, however we want to ensure our products are as environmentally friendly as possible, and are committed to completely neutralising our carbon footprint and environmental impact.”
~$7M USD GRANT TO NONPROFITS
NFTs are not only suitable for collectors, but are proving to be great fundraising mechanisms for purpose-driven causes including the environment. The VeVe grant will establish a pool of OMI tokens which can be used to pay for artwork, development and minting of NFTs where the proceeds go to the nonprofit. Additionally, the funds may be used for matching donations and other environmentally beneficial functions.
ABOUT VEVE
VeVe sits at the nexus of pop culture- combining toys, games and collectibles to offer a unique way to experience the many worlds of fandom. Through technological innovations VeVe makes new forms of content accessible to consumers and is disrupting the collectible world of today. At VeVe, we see digital collectibles as a new class of collectible, which also offers intellectual property owners the opportunity for new revenue streams in the digital landscape.
The VeVe Digital Collectible app is available on both iOS and Android.

titre: First Look: VeVe Master Collector Program
resume: The Master Collector Program will bring exciting benefits to every VeVe Collector — here’s a look at the work in progress
texte:
First Look: VeVe Master Collector Program

The Master Collector Program will bring exciting benefits to every VeVe Collector — here’s a look at the work in progress

VeVe Digital CollectiblesFollow

Oct 28 · 11 min read

We’re very excited to finally share a first look at the details behind how the Master Collector Program will work on VeVe!
The Master Collector Program (MCP) is a new loyalty program available to all users designed to reward active VeVe Collectors. Through the MCP, Collectors can level up by being an active VeVe Collector, completing objectives, all while gaining benefits and rewards in a quest to reach the highest level of Master Collector.
Dive into all the exciting details below.
PLEASE NOTE — This is a work-in-progress plan. The information below is an initial outline of the various elements in the Master Collector Program. Details are subject to change based on development and feedback.
In this article, a “Collectible” refers to all items that can be purchased in the VeVe Store, e.g. 3D collectibles and digital comics.
There will be measures in place to prevent users from exploiting, abusing or otherwise gaming the system, so don’t make any rash decisions about your collections or purchasing activity based on this article.
If you have questions and/or suggestions about any of the below, please fill out our feedback form HERE.

Summary:
All VeVe app users are automatically enrolled in the MCP
Points will be awarded retroactively to all active VeVe users
All new VeVe Collectors are entered into the MCP, starting at Level 0
Collectors level up by earning Points from in-app activity
Collectors can earn one-off Points and/or daily recurring Points
Once the required Points are earned, the Collector will proceed to the next Level.
Collectors can spend earned Points on various features and products within VeVe. Spending Points does not affect your Level or Rank.
Collectors also will earn a Rank based on their Level and Points earned.
A Collector’s Rank position is determined by their activity relative to other Collectors
Level Points
In order to level up, a Collector must earn Points. Points are awarded to Collectors for in-app activity. For example, Points can be earned for one-off actions, such as purchasing a collectible and/or earned daily by owning collectibles or holding completed Sets. Once earned, Points can be spent on various in-app items and are non-transferable. Points can be earned from the following activities…
One-off Points
+100 Points when completing new user onboarding
+100 Points Received when completing a Set
+25 Points when purchasing collectibles in the Store
+15 Points when purchasing collectibles in the Market
+Variable amount when earning an Achievement Badge depending on Achievement type
Daily Recurring Points
Collectors can earn daily recurring Points based on their collection and in-app activity.
Collectibles:
+1 Point is given for each Collectible owned.
If duplicate Collectibles are held, these will be subject to diminishing Points:
- 2nd Collectible: 0.75 Points
- 3rd Collectible: 0.35 Points
- 4 Collectibles or more: 0.10 Points
Collectible Bonus Points:
Collectibles of specific rarities and/or mints will receive bonus Points.
Rarity Bonus Points:
+ 0.20 Points: Rare
+ 0.30 Points: Ultra Rare
+ 0.50 Points: Secret Rare
Low Edition Bonus:
+ 0.5 Points: Collectibles with a sub #150 mint
+ 0.5 Points: Digital Comics with the first 150 available to the public
Collectible Sets:
As Sets offer a varying number of collectibles, the points earned are based on the number of Collectibles within the Set:
+ 6.0 Points: 5 Collectibles or more
+ 5.0 Points: 4 Collectibles
+ 3.5 Points: 3 Collectibles
+ 2.5 Points: 2 Collectibles
+ 1.5 Points: 1 Collectible
Duplicate Sets:
If you own one or more of the same Set, the additional Sets are subject to a reduced amount of Points vs. unique Sets.
- 2nd set: 30% Points vs. unique Sets 
- 3rd set: 20% Points vs. unique Sets
- 4th set and on: 10% Points vs. unique Sets
For Example, if you own two (2) Superman collectible Sets, you would get 1.95 Points daily (1 Superman = 1.5 Points, 2nd Superman = .45 Points, etc.).
Digital Comic Series:
If a Collector owns all released issues in a specific Series, they will receive 5 Points daily. For example - if VeVe has released four issues of Amazing Spider-Man, and a Collector owns all four issues, they will receive daily Points for each issue, plus 5 Points for owning all released comic issues in the Series.
If an additional issue is released in the Series, one must collect that issue as well to continue earning the comic Series Points. A comic Series qualifies for Points when 3 or more issues in the Series have been dropped on VeVe.
In-app activity:
- 1 Point is received for all in-app activity actions
- In-app activities will have a maximum limit of 25 Points per day
- In-app activity includes daily logins, sharing, commenting, liking, Market listings, etc. Additional activities will be added in the future.
Earning Points:
- Points are earned on activities/transactions that take place within VeVe
- Recurring Points stop accruing after 14 days of inactivity
- Points have a shelf life and must be spent within 6 months of earning (there will be an indication in the app on the amount of Points needed to be spent before a certain date)
- Points are calculated and applied once per 24hr period at a set time each day
- Points have 2 decimal places
- Earned points may change during certain periods — e.g. Double Point Bonus Days
Retroactive Points:
When the MCP is officially launched, level Points will be calculated from the time a Collector’s VeVe account was created. The number of Points received will only be calculated based on the number of Collectibles and Sets the Collector owns in that time. Collectors will also receive One-Off Points for Store Purchases, Market Purchases, and Completed Sets.
Safety Measures:
There will be additional measures in place to prevent users from exploiting, abusing, or otherwise gaming the system, so don’t make any rash decisions about your collections or purchasing activity based on this article.
Levels, Ranks, Badges
The Master Collector Program consists of Levels and Ranks. Levels start at Level 0 (new user) and increase as the Collector earns Points. Each VeVe Collector also has a Rank, and a Collector’s Rank position is determined by their activity relative to other Collectors. For example, the top percentile of Collectors will likely have a high Level and the Rank of Master Collector.
Levels
To level up, the Collector must earn the required amount of Points to go from one level to the next. Each Level has a required amount of Points, and when enough Points are earned, the Collector will level up. Leveling is exponential and more Points are required as the Levels get higher.
Each Collector’s Level is displayed on their Profile page within an MCP badge, and the Collector Level shows wherever their Profile is visible, such as on their Profile page, Feed posts, or Market listings.
As Collectors reach specific milestone Levels, they will gain access to items and new or expanded features within VeVe. For example, Milestone 3D Level badges (e.g. one for every 10 levels, displayable in Showrooms), expanded profile, a free number of Premium Market Listings (more below), expanded AR features, Drop Lottery access (more below), accessories, exclusive content, level-based chat rooms, and more.
Rank
Along with Levels, the MCP consists of 23 Ranks. The Collector’s Rank is based on their position relative to other VeVe Collectors. The lowest Rank is Bronze I and the highest Rank is Master Collector. The 23 ranks are divided based on percentages. For example, the highest Rank, Master Collector, is reserved for the top percentile of Collectors.
Unlike Levels, Ranks are not static or kept permanently. As a Collector, your Rank position can move up or down based on your performance relative to other Collectors. For example, you might be a mid-tier Rank, and if your Rank was to increase, you may replace a Collector in a higher Rank, who would move down a Rank position.
Badges
Various activities within VeVe will reward collectors with Achievement Badges — for example, completing a Set. Badges are displayed on the Collector’s public Profile and some Badges can be added to your Showrooms. When a new Badge is earned, the Collector will receive Points.
Drop Lottery
The MCP Drop Lottery gives Collectors a greater chance to obtain a specific collectible in an upcoming drop. A small percentage of editions of each rarity in a drop will be made available for this lottery.
Users can participate in the Drop Lottery by wagering Points they have earned. The odds of winning in a lottery are weighted by the number of Points a Collector wagers, relative to other Drop Lottery participants.
The top group of people (number varies based on edition size per drop) who wager the most amount of Points are guaranteed the collectible — this is not a raffle system.
How It Works:
At a set time before a drop, the MCP Drop Lottery will open to those Collectors with the required level of access. The Collector can choose which collectible and rarity they want to wager Points on. The number of Collectors wagering on a collectible will be shown, but the amount wagered will not. All Points wagered in the MCP Drop Lottery are spent post-drop, regardless of whether the lottery was won or not.
The MCP Drop Lottery will close a short time before a drop and then the winners are announced. The winner must claim the collectible before the drop takes place. If a collectible is not claimed before the drop, it is returned to the public drop pool. When a winning collectible is claimed, the Collector is prompted to make the payment (in Gems), and the collectible will be delivered to their collection post-drop.
Accessories
Within the Store, various Accessories will be made available for purchase using Points. Accessories that can be purchased with Points will (generally) be non-licensed, high-edition items, allowing Collectors to trick out their Showrooms.
Premium Market Listings
Premium Market Listings allow for greater exposure when selling items in the VeVe Market. Collectors can spend Points for Premium Market Listings, which will display before non-Premium Listings for any given collectible. To prevent the Market from being overrun with Premium Listings, only a select number of Premium Listings will be available for any one collectible. Premium Listings will be featured on the Market > Landing screen as well as when viewing specific collectibles.
MCP Pro
MCP Pro is designed for those collectors who want to take their collecting to the next level. With MCP Pro, Collectors can gain exclusive features within VeVe to grow their collection and access additional Pro-only features. Collectors in the top six Ranks will automatically gain access to MCP Pro at no cost, whereas all other Collectors who opt-in will be charged a monthly subscription (pricing to be shared at a later date). The subscription will be accessible only above a specific Level.
Features:
- Small percentage bonus on all Points earned
- Exclusive MCP Pro Badges to display in Showrooms
- Premium User Profile Badge
- Display rarity and edition # next to Collectibles in Showrooms and AR
- Auto-bid feature for Market Auctions
- Access to exclusive content (Accessories/Collectibles)
- Burn Collectibles for Points
- And more…
Roadmap
To make the MCP available to Collectors in an expedient manner, the MCP features will be rolled out in phases, with each phase focusing on key aspects of the MCP:
Phase 1: Points, Levels, Ranks
Phase 2: Drop Lottery
Phase 3: Accessories, Premium Market Listings, Badges
Phase 4: MCP Pro
FAQ
Who has access to the MCP?
All registered users will automatically be enrolled in the MCP, starting at Level 0.
When will the MCP be available in VeVe?
Development on Phase 1 is now underway, and once complete, the following phases will go into development.
When will each phase be released? 
We will aim to release each phase as soon as possible. That said, development timelines can change due to varying factors, so we cannot give a precise release date until closer to release. Each of the phases will release when ready (e.g. #soon).
Will Points be retroactive?
Yes. Points will be calculated from the day VeVe launched, so your activity within VeVe to date will contribute to your MCP Level and Rank. The number of Points received will only be calculated based on the number of Collectibles and Sets the Collector owns in that time.
Collectibles received via transfer will not receive the one-off Points listed earlier in the article, but will also be calculated retroactively from the time you acquired them. More simply, you will get points for holding and set completion, but not for off-platform purchases.
Why is MCP Pro available to the top six Ranks?
At VeVe we support the Collectors who are the most active, so it was a no-brainer to make these features available to these Collectors.
If I held Collectibles and Sets in the past, but sold them before the MCP releases, will I still earn Points for the time I held those Sets/collectibles?
Yes, those Collectibles/Sets will still earn Points retroactively for the time you held them, even if you don’t hold them anymore once the MCP starts.
Will transferred collectibles count towards the MCP?
Collectibles received from a transfer will receive Daily Points, however as they’re not purchased from Store or Market, they will not receive the One-Off Points for Purchase (see the One-Off Points section).
Will holding unique Sets earn more Points than duplicates of the same Set?
Yes, duplicate Sets will have diminishing bonuses vs. unique Sets (see the Collectible Sets section of the article).
Do the Rarity bonuses also apply to Digital Comics, and do Digital Comics earn points otherwise?
Yes, rarity bonuses apply to Digital Comics as well as the rest of the Collectibles. However, Digital Comics do not have traditional Sets, so Set bonuses will not apply to Digital Comics.
Instead of Set bonuses, Series bonuses will apply for Digital Comics. For example, you will get bonus Points for having the full Amazing Spider-Man comic Series released to that point (see the Digital Comic Series section).
Will we be able to earn/use Points in the VeVeVerse?
Yes, Points can be earned and used within the VeVeVerse. More details will be released closer to the launch of the VeVeVerse.
What about OMI Utility?
OMI Utility will be a separate program and article, but there will be some overlap with MCP, so stay tuned for more on that soon.

PLEASE NOTE — This is a work-in-progress plan. The information below is an initial outline of the various elements in the Master Collector Program. Details are subject to change based on development and feedback. In this article, a “Collectible” refers to all items that can be purchased in the VeVe Store, e.g. 3D collectibles and digital comics.
There will be measures in place to prevent users from exploiting, abusing or otherwise gaming the system, so don’t make any rash decisions about your collections or purchasing activity based on this article.

resume: One of the best-selling books ever published, The Little Prince, brings imagery from the beloved novella to digital collectibles!
texte:
VeVe Welcomes The Little Prince

One of the best-selling books ever published, The Little Prince, brings imagery from the beloved novella to the world of digital collectibles.

VeVe.Follow

Sep 17 · 3 min read

First published in France in 1943, Le Petit Prince tells a simple yet philosophical tale of a grown-up meeting his inner child, a young prince, who travels the universe gaining insight, knowledge, and wisdom about life and nature.
Passed down for more than 75 years, the novella is now available in more than 300 languages and is one of the best-selling books in publishing history, having sold more than 200 million copies worldwide.
Antoine de Saint-Exupéry’s beloved tale has also been adapted and brought to life in a wide range of mediums, including plays, films, TV series, operas, ballets, and even brings the journey to life with a dedicated theme park.
“We are very humbled to work with one of the most revered novels of all time. The Little Prince has resonated among countless generations and we’re excited to offer collectors a new, unique way to engage with the storied tale and own digital collectibles that celebrate its legacy.”
— David Yu, CEO, VeVe

Le Petit Prince juxtaposes the often narrow-minded adult persona against the open-minded nature of children, allowing them to explore the world around them, and within them, through an uncorrupted lens. The main theme of the fable is expressed in the secret that the fox tells the little prince: “It is only with the heart that one can see rightly: what is essential is invisible to the eye.”
The original 140-page manuscript of the novella, as well as a number of drafts and early illustrations, are also on permanent display at the Morgan Library & Museum in Manhattan, New York City

VeVe x The Little Prince
VeVe is incredibly humbled to bring imagery from The Little Prince to life as digital collectible NFTs. Not only will this be the first literature-related release on the platform, but it is also one that is sure to touch the hearts and memories of our French collectors, and introduce this timeless tale to new fans across the world.
“We are proud to have The Little Prince represented in the NFT phenomenon. The Little Prince phenomenon knows no boundaries: all generations, all continents are touched by this work of art. We are grateful for this opportunity to enter a new realm of possibilities.”
— Mr Olivier d’Agay, head of the Saint Exupéry Estate.

Across these varied cultures, many traditions exist for ringing in a new year of good luck and prosperity.
