resume: The MCP will bring exciting benefits to every VeVe Collector — here’s the launch candidate outline.
texte:
VeVe Master Collector Program v1.0

The MCP will bring exciting benefits to every VeVe Collector — here’s the launch candidate outline.

VeVeFollow

Dec 23 · 10 min read

The Master Collector Program (MCP) is a new loyalty program available to all users designed to reward active VeVe Collectors. Through the MCP, Collectors can level up by being an active VeVe Collector, completing objectives, all while gaining benefits and rewards in a quest to reach the highest level of Master Collector.
Version History
A Summary of the changes from MCP v0.2 to v1.0 can be seen here.

Summary:
All VeVe app users are automatically enrolled in the MCP
Points will be awarded retroactively to all active VeVe users
All new VeVe Collectors are entered into the MCP, starting at Level 0
Collectors level up by earning Points from in-app activity
Collectors can earn one-off Points and/or daily recurring Points
Once the required Points are earned, the Collector will proceed to the next Level.
Collectors can spend earned Points on various features and products within VeVe. Spending Points does not affect your Level or Rank.
Collectors also will earn a Rank based on their Level and Points earned.
A Collector’s Rank position is determined by their activity relative to other Collectors

Level Points
In order to level up, a Collector must earn Points. Points are awarded to Collectors for in-app activity. For example, Points can be earned for one-off actions, such as purchasing a collectible and/or earned daily by owning collectibles or holding completed Sets. Once earned, Points can be spent on various in-app items and are non-transferable. Points can be earned from the following activities…
One-off Points
+100 Points when completing new user onboarding
+100 Points Received when completing a Set
+25 Points when purchasing collectibles in the Store
+15 Points when purchasing collectibles in the Market
+Variable amount when earning an Achievement Badge depending on Achievement type
Daily Recurring Points
Collectors can earn daily recurring Points based on their collection and in-app activity. Comic daily points are outlined in the “Comics: Daily Points” section.
Collectibles Points:
+1 Point is given for each Collectible owned.
If duplicate Collectibles are held, these will be subject to diminishing Points:
- 2nd Collectible: 0.75 Points
- 3rd Collectible: 0.35 Points
- 4 Collectibles or more: 0.10 Points
Collectible Bonus Points:
Collectibles of specific rarities and/or mints will receive bonus Points.
Rarity Bonus Points:
+ 0.25 Points: Rare
+ 0.50 Points: Ultra Rare
+ 5.00 Points: Secret Rare
Low Edition Bonus:
+ 0.5 Points: Points earned for the 5% lowest mints available to the public (excludes any Comics retained by VeVe)
Collectible Set Points:
As Sets offer a varying number of collectibles, the points earned are based on the number of Collectibles within the Set:
+ 5.0 Points: 5 Collectibles or more
+ 4.0 Points: 4 Collectibles
+ 3.0 Points: 3 Collectibles
+ 2.0 Points: 2 Collectibles
+ 1.0 Points: 1 Collectible
Duplicate Set Points:
If you own one or more of the same Set, the additional Sets are subject to a reduced amount of Points vs. unique Sets.
+ 2nd set: 30% Points vs. unique Sets 
+ 3rd set: 20% Points vs. unique Sets
+ 4th set and on: 10% Points vs. unique Sets
For Example, if you own two (2) Superman collectible Sets, you would get 1.3 Points daily (1 Superman = 1.0 Points, 2nd Superman = .30 Points, etc.).

Comics: Daily Points
Daily Comic Points are based on the rarity of the Comic — for example, 0.25 Points for a Common up to 6 points for a Secret Rare. Daily Comic Points are earned as follows:
+ Common 0.25 points
+ Uncommon 0.50 points
+ Rare 2.00 points
+ Ultra Rare 3.00 points
+ Secret Rare 6.00 points
Duplicate Comics
If duplicate Comics rarities Rare, Ultra Rare and Secret Rare are held, these will be subject to diminishing Points. Common and Uncommon are excluded
+ 2nd 50% of the points
+ 3rd 25% of the points
+ 4th + 10% of the points
Comics: Low Mint Bonus
+ 50% Points earned for the 5% lowest mint Comic available to the public (excludes any Comics retained by VeVe)

In-app activity:
- 1 Point is received for all in-app activity actions
- In-app activities will have a maximum limit of 25 Points per day
- In-app activity includes daily logins, sharing, commenting, liking, Market listings, etc. Additional activities will be added in the future.

Earning Points:
- Points are earned on activities/transactions that take place within VeVe
- Recurring Points stop accruing after 14 days of inactivity
- Points have a shelf life and must be spent within 6 months of earning (there will be an indication in the app on the amount of Points needed to be spent before a certain date). Points which are closest to expiring will be used first
- Points are calculated and applied once per 24hr period at a set time each day
- Points have 2 decimal places
- Earned points may change during certain periods — e.g. Double Point Bonus Days
Retroactive Points:
When the MCP is officially launched, level Points will be calculated from the time a Collector’s VeVe account was created. The number of Points received will only be calculated based on the number of Collectibles and Sets the Collector owns in that time. Collectors will also receive One-Off Points for Store Purchases, Market Purchases, and Completed Sets.
Point Limitations:
Various measures will be in place to prevent users from exploiting, abusing, or otherwise gaming the system. Here are some examples:
Sets: Points for completing a set can only be earned once per set, e.g. a user cannot complete a Set, sell a collectible from the Set, and then buy it back to complete the Set again.
Market: Points for purchasing are applied once per collectible, e.g. you can’t purchase the same low-cost collectible over and over to gain Points. 
Additionally, Market Purchase Points are earned for the first 5 collectible Market purchases daily, e.g. you can’t spend the day buying different low-cost collectibles to infinitely gain points.

Levels, Ranks, Badges
The Master Collector Program consists of Levels and Ranks. Levels start at Level 0 (new user) and increase as the Collector earns Points. Each VeVe Collector also has a Rank, and a Collector’s Rank position is determined by their activity relative to other Collectors. For example, the top percentile of Collectors will likely have a high Level and the Rank of Master Collector.
Levels
To level up, the Collector must earn the required amount of Points to go from one level to the next. Each Level has a required amount of Points, and when enough Points are earned, the Collector will level up. Leveling is exponential and more Points are required as the Levels get higher.
Each Collector’s Level is displayed on their Profile page within an MCP badge, and the Collector Level shows wherever their Profile is visible, such as on their Profile page, Feed posts, or Market listings.
As Collectors reach specific milestone Levels, they will gain access to items and new or expanded features within VeVe. For example, Milestone 3D Level badges (e.g. one for every 10 levels, displayable in Showrooms), expanded profile, a free number of Premium Market Listings (more below), expanded AR features, Drop Raffle access (more below), accessories, exclusive content, level-based chat rooms, and more.
Rank
Along with Levels, the MCP consists of 23 Ranks. The Collector’s Rank is based on their position relative to other VeVe Collectors. The lowest Rank is Bronze I and the highest Rank is Master Collector. The 23 ranks are divided based on percentages. For example, the highest Rank, Master Collector, is reserved for the top percentile of Collectors.
Unlike Levels, Ranks are not static or kept permanently. As a Collector, your Rank position can move up or down based on your performance relative to other Collectors. For example, you might be a mid-tier Rank, and if your Rank was to increase, you may replace a Collector in a higher Rank, who would move down a Rank position.
Badges
Various activities within VeVe will reward collectors with Achievement Badges — for example, completing a Set. Badges are displayed on the Collector’s public Profile and some Badges can be added to your Showrooms. When a new Badge is earned, the Collector will receive Points.

Drop Raffle
The MCP Drop Raffle gives Collectors a greater chance to obtain a specific collectible in an upcoming drop. A percentage of editions, of each rarity, in a drop will be made available for the raffle. Users can participate in the Drop Raffle by using their Points to purchase a Drop Raffle ticket. The more tickets a Collector has relative to other Drop Raffle participants, the greater the chance of success.
The Collector can buy as many raffle tickets as their Points will allow. When the Drop Raffle closes, winners will be randomly selected from the pool of ticket holders. Those successful in the Drop Raffle can purchase their chosen collectible, and the Points for all Drop Raffle tickets the winner purchased will be spent. Collectors who are unsuccessful in the Drop Raffle will get 90% of their Points returned.
How It Works:
At a set time before a drop, the MCP Drop Raffle will open to those Collectors above the required MCP level. The Collector can choose which collectible and rarity they want to buy Drop Raffle tickets for. The number of Collectors competing for a collectible will be shown, however, the number of Drop Raffle tickets will not be known.
The MCP Drop Raffle will close a short time before a drop and successful Collectors will be notified. The winners must claim the collectible before the drop takes place. If a collectible is not claimed before the drop, it is returned to the public drop pool. When a winning collectible is claimed, the Collector is prompted to make the payment (in Gems), and the collectible will be delivered to their collection post-drop.

Accessories
Within the Store, various Accessories will be made available for purchase using Points. Accessories that can be purchased with Points will (generally) be non-licensed, high-edition items, allowing Collectors to trick out their Showrooms.

Premium Market Listings
Premium Market Listings allow for greater exposure when selling items in the VeVe Market. Collectors can spend Points for Premium Market Listings, which will display before non-Premium Listings for any given collectible. To prevent the Market from being overrun with Premium Listings, only a select number of Premium Listings will be available for any one collectible. Premium Listings will be featured on the Market > Landing screen as well as when viewing specific collectibles.

MCP Pro
MCP Pro is designed for those collectors who want to take their collecting to the next level. With MCP Pro, Collectors can gain exclusive features within VeVe to grow their collection and access additional Pro-only features. Collectors in the top six Ranks will automatically gain access to MCP Pro at no cost, whereas all other Collectors who opt-in will be charged a monthly subscription (pricing to be shared at a later date). The subscription will be accessible only above a specific Level.
Features:
- Small percentage bonus on all Points earned
- Exclusive MCP Pro Badges to display in Showrooms
- Premium User Profile Badge
- Display rarity and edition # next to Collectibles in Showrooms and AR
- Auto-bid feature for Market Auctions
- Access to exclusive content (Accessories/Collectibles)
- Burn Collectibles for Points
- Free Drop Raffle tickets per month
- Renting Collectibles
- Extended AR features
- And more to come…

Roadmap
To make the MCP available to Collectors in an expedient manner, features will be rolled out in phases, with each phase focusing on key aspects of the program:
Phase 1: Points, Levels, Ranks
Phase 2: Drop Raffle
Phase 3: Accessories, Premium Market Listings, Badges
Phase 4: MCP Pro

FAQ
Who has access to the MCP?
All registered users will automatically be enrolled in the MCP, starting at Level 0.
When will the MCP be available in VeVe?
Development on Phase 1 is now underway, and once complete, the following phases will go into development.
When will each phase be released? 
We will aim to release each phase as soon as possible. That said, development timelines can change due to varying factors, so we cannot give a precise release date until closer to release. Each of the phases will release when ready (e.g. #soon).
Will Points be retroactive?
Yes. Points will be calculated from the day VeVe launched, so your activity within VeVe to date will contribute to your MCP Level and Rank. The number of Points received will only be calculated based on the number of Collectibles and Sets the Collector owns in that time.
Collectibles received via transfer will not receive the one-off Points listed earlier in the article, but will also be calculated retroactively from the time you acquired them. More simply, you will get points for holding and set completion, but not for off-platform purchases.
Why is MCP Pro available to the top six Ranks?
At VeVe we support the Collectors who are the most active, so it was a no-brainer to make these features available to these Collectors.
If I held Collectibles and Sets in the past, but sold them before the MCP releases, will I still earn Points for the time I held those Sets/collectibles?
Yes, those Collectibles/Sets will still earn Points retroactively for the time you held them, even if you don’t hold them anymore once the MCP starts.
Will transferred collectibles count towards the MCP?
Collectibles received from a transfer will receive Daily Points, however as they’re not purchased from Store or Market, they will not receive the One-Off Points for Purchase (see the One-Off Points section).
Will holding unique Sets earn more Points than duplicates of the same Set?
Yes, duplicate Sets will have diminishing bonuses vs. unique Sets (see the Collectible Sets section of the article).
Do the Rarity bonuses also apply to Digital Comics, and do Digital Comics earn points otherwise?
Yes, rarity bonuses apply to Digital Comics as well as the rest of the Collectibles. However, Digital Comics do not have traditional Sets, so Set bonuses will not apply to Digital Comics.
Will we be able to earn/use Points in the VeVeVerse?
Yes, Points can be earned and used within the VeVeVerse. More details will be released closer to the launch of the VeVeVerse.
What about OMI Utility?
OMI Utility will be a separate program and article, but there will be some overlap with MCP, so stay tuned for more on that soon.

PLEASE NOTE:
There will be measures in place to prevent users from exploiting, abusing or otherwise gaming the system, so don’t make any rash decisions about your collections or purchasing activity based on this article.

Gary Baseman
Gary Baseman is known for his broad art practice that includes award-winning illustration and animation (Emmy and BAFTA-award winning Teacher’s Pet), fine art, performance, toy design and fashion. Baseman coined the term “Pervasive Art” in the early 2000s and states, “Art can be appropriate in almost any medium, from print to TV to film to paintings to consumer products, as long as you stay true to your aesthetic and have a strong sense of meaning.” Baseman continues to blur boundaries of art, expanding into the depths of the digital world.

Toby
Toby is artist Gary Baseman’s iconic character featured in fine art, photography, video, performance, advertising, fashion and toy design. Known as everyone’s “best friend” and “keeper of secrets,” Toby is an all-knowing and compassionate cat with a great sense of curiosity and adventure.
Baseman blurred the lines of fine art and toy culture in 2005 with the introduction of Toby as a limited edition 16-inch plush figure that could only be acquired at a fine art gallery. As Baseman says, “Toby is omnipresent, sees all, knows all, accepts and loves you. Toby truly loves you.”
Series 1
Series 1 introduces Baseman’s iconic character in the digital collectible realm, showing off his playfulness and compassion. Toby appears on the move, never sitting still, because he is the seeker of truth and understanding. His curiosity drives him to float and fly, listen and laugh, and best of all, welcomes all into the conversation.
He wants to get to know everyone and everything, He crosses borders and disarms all with his toothy smile and open arms. He’s the kind of guy that everyone wants to be around. He is everyone’s best friend and loves all unconditionally.

Luke Chueh x Munkyking
Munkyking started in ’03 in Chinatown LA, Southern California’s first designer toy store. They expanded to a gallery and flagship store on Melrose, fueling the genre’s growth with art shows, signings, releases and events. The brand has moved away from retail and spent the last decade creating designer toys with a roster of renown pop-surrealist artists.
Born in Philly, raised in Fresno, Luke Chueh, pronounced CHU, studied graphic design at Cal Poly (BS in Art & Design). After an award-winning illustration and design career, Chueh moved to LA in 2003, launching his fine art career at the iconic, underground art show, Cannibal Flower. Chueh has since grown into an LA art scene staple, employing minimal color schemes, simple animal characters, and an endless list of ill-fated situations. He stylistically balances cute with brute, walking the line between comedy and tragedy, and has been featured in galleries worldwide with many paintings turned into vinyl toys.

Headspace Black Bear
“Headspace” is based on a series of paintings created by Luke Chueh over the past few years. The series is Luke’s attempt to give credit to the things that have had an impact on his life/career.
The black bear in the white costume is a theme Luke has been illustrating throughout his career. The idea of showing one thing while internally being the polar opposite is a feeling Luke believes that everyone can empathize with.

— Lev Levarek, Founder Toy Tokyo

Meet Lev Levarek

Source: WSJ

Israel “lev” Levarek started dealing with toys in the early ’80s, where collecting was a BIG Hobby of his, especially ROBOTS and BATMAN toys. Lev travelled far and wide, going to countries to hunt down RARE and hard to find toys, that his collector friends needed in the USA (way before the interwebs was around).
After many successful toy hunting expeditions, travelling to Spain to hunt special Marvel Secret Wars figures, and Istanbul, Turkey to locate special UZAY blue Snowtrooper figure, Lev decided to open his first store in Evanston, Illinois, called It’s a Small World.
However, one day later, Lev decided to close the store and instead took the revolutionary step of creating a toy catalogue, the first-ever in full color, which contained every cool toy that anyone ever dreamed of owning. After selling out in record time, Lev was spurred on and devoted his life to toys and collecting.

A small corner in Toy Tokyo, New York City

Toy Tokyo was opened in New York City in 2000, introducing the first Designer Art Vinyl Toys by MICHAEL LAU & BOUNTY HUNTER, including the first KAWS COMPANIONS, all sold in Toy Tokyo.
Nowadays, Lev and Toy Tokyo mingle with the who’s who in the collectible and designer toy world, offering exclusive and limited edition content from classic brands like Funko, such as this FUNKO TOY TOKYO PLANET ARLIA VEGETA Toy Tokyo Exclusive, which is now selling for ~US$2.5k:

resume: To help you remain vigilant and protect your collectibles from nefarious operators and bad actors we want to reiterate the basics of…
texte:
VeVe Account Security

VeVeFollow

Apr 5 · 2 min read

To help you remain vigilance and protect your collectibles from nefarious operators and bad actors we want to reiterate the basics of account security, and the process for reporting if you believe your account has been compromised.
You must manage the security and management of VeVe accounts and passwords with the same level of security you use with your finance and banking access.
All data provided by VeVe users, such as emails and passwords, are fully encrypted within VeVe’s databases, and there have been no data breaches.
Protecting Your VeVe Account
1. Use a STRONG password — This means a combination of letters, numbers and symbols, and a password that you’ve never used before. We also strongly recommend a unique password generator. The more characters and digits the better.
2. Ensure the email account you have registered with VeVe has not been compromised.
3. Ensure your device has not been compromised (use an anti-virus).
4. Treat your VeVe app and phone as you would your banking information. Please log out of each session, have pin-code security on your device, and implement measures (anti-virus) to prevent malware from living on your device.
5. ECOMI/VeVe will NEVER ask you for your password, nor are there any ‘customer support’ staff in telegram. Any and all support MUST go through veve.me/support. Any other contact is likely a scam or phishing attempt — please remain vigilant.
6. We do not support, nor are we responsible for, any trading outside of the VeVe app. We strongly recommend waiting until the Marketplace is completely open to buy/trade/sell with other users.
What Do I Do if My Account Has Been Compromised?
If you believe your account has been compromised, please change your password immediately, then open a ticket at veve.me/support
What Will VeVe Do About It?
We take security very seriously. With each security claim, an investigation is launched and the first step taken is to freeze the accounts involved — this is why you must report any issue as soon as possible. During the investigation, the accounts involved are tracked, and where possible/provable items taken may be returned to their original owners.
When Can I Add 2FA to My Account?
Two-factor authentication is in its final stages of testing and will be enabled soon. This is an optional security measure, however, we strongly recommend all users enable it on their accounts. We will also be adding biometric security measures (such as face ID) in a coming update, however, 2FA will be available first.
In the meantime, please ensure you are using a STRONG password, and change this regularly, as you do with other banking and financial account protection.

Memento Moa
Memento Moa is a new series of original art created by Gary Baseman for an exhibition in New Zealand. Exploring themes of migration, memory, and mortality, Baseman creates a mythical land of hybrid creatures. Playing off the phrase “memento mori” which expresses the inevitability of death, Baseman reimagines Aotearoa New Zealand as a land of rebirth and harmony, bringing back the giant moa from extinction to symbolize those loved and now lost. Through iconic characters set in fantastical landscapes, Memento Moa considers family, history, and the idea of home with the artist’s long standing desire to “celebrate the beauty of the bittersweetness of life.”

Merge Accounts: What You Need To Know

Everything you need to know about how to merge Collectibles and Gems from multiple VeVe accounts into one.

Merging Accounts
A number of users have been waiting to consolidate their accounts and merge their assets under one username. This will soon be available through the merge accounts feature, and users will be able to consolidate a maximum of 4 accounts into their main username (5 total). Stay tuned to our socials and this article for news on when this feature is available.
KYC: What You Need To Know
Know Your Customer (KYC) is how you will get verified in order to access all features of the VeVe app including Payout.

medium.com

Merging accounts is a web-app-only feature, and using it, a non-KYC’d account can merge with an account that has completed the KYC process, provided the account is either your personal account (or if you are the parent or legal guardian of a child with an account under the VeVe minimum age, that child’s account) .
This feature will permanently transfer all of the collectibles, comics, showrooms, and gems from the non-KYC’d account to the main, KYC’d account. MCP points will not be merged.
When merging accounts, you will first need to log into the account you wish to transfer from. This account will be deactivated once the merging process is complete, and during the request process, you will be able to nominate the account you are transferring your inventory to.
The account you are merging from must:
Be in good standing (not disabled, not a bot-created account, etc.)
Not be KYC’d
When the merge accounts feature is available, the process will be as follows
From the account you wish to merge into your main account, log in to the VeVe Web app. You can do this using the same credentials you use to log into the mobile app, and will need to enter the 2FA code sent to your registered email account
Open the settings menu (top right) and select the ‘Merge Accounts’ option
Read the information provided, and select ‘begin’ when you are ready to proceed
Enter the email address of the nominated KYC’d account (the one you’re transferring all of your assets to) and click submit
You will be required to enter 2FA codes from the requesting account and the nominated account.
You will then be able to view the total number of collectibles, comics, gems, and showrooms that will be transferred to the nominated account if you proceed
If you wish to proceed with the transfer and merge, click ‘next’ and you will be prompted to enter 2FA codes again from your registered account email, and pass facial 2FA, before the process will be initiated.
After passing the 2FA, you will see the success screen, which has additional information about the next steps and expectations.
Note: The account merge will take place 48 hours after the request has been initiated, and you will receive an email to both the nominated KYC’d account and the account you are merging, with details of the request. This email also contains a cancellation link, and you will have up to 48 hours to cancel the merge request. After this time, the merge CANNOT be canceled.

Crypto Pay-In: What You Need To Know

Everything you need to know about how to purchase Gems with crypto on VeVe!

Collectors and crypto-enthusiasts will be able to enter the VeVe Collectibles experience using their digital assets. Here is an outline covering how Crypto Pay-In will work when released. Stay tuned to our socials and this article for news on when Crypto Pay-In is available.
Crypto Pay-In (Crypto to Gem)
Crypto Pay-In is a new feature allowing users to purchase Gems using some large-cap digital assets and stablecoins. You will do this through the VeVe web app, and the process is similar to purchasing Gems using a Credit Card.
VeVe Collectors will also have the choice of 5 tokens to “pay-in” with: Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), USDT, USDC, and Binance USD (bUSD).
Log into the VeVe web app using the same credentials you use to log into the VeVe mobile app (this feature is only available through the web app).
Open the settings menu and select My Wallet, and then Get More Gems.
Enter the number of Gems you wish to purchase and select ‘Cryptocurrency’ as the payment option. There is currently a $10,000 weekly limit.
If you are using BTC you can send it using the Bitcoin blockchain. ALL other tokens are ERC20, so please DO NOT use any network other than Ethereum to send bUSD, USDT, USDC, and ETH. ⚠️
Select the token you wish to make the payment with and you will be presented with the current market price and conversion rate for that purchase, as well as how much of the token you need to send to complete the payment. A 3% fee is applied to all crypto-to-Gem transactions.
This rate will be live for 15 minutes. If payment is received outside of that time a new rate will be applied, and the number of Gems you receive will be adjusted accordingly.
If you’re happy with the rate, click next. Then, you will be given a QR code and wallet address to send your crypto to, in order to complete the payment. This QR code will also be sent to you via email.
Once you have completed the payment, return to the VeVe web app and select ‘I Have Made Payment.’
You will see additional instructions and what to expect. Depending on the cryptocurrency used and the network congestion at the time, transactions may take several minutes to complete.
You will receive an email from Wyre (the payment services provider) once the payment has been received, and it may take some time from this point before the Gems are credited to your account.
Users can only process one Crypto Pay-In transaction at a time. If you fail to make the payment or change your mind you will need to wait 15 minutes before you can process a new transaction.

Receiving Your Gems
When the transaction is complete, your Gem balance will be automatically credited and you will receive in-app and email notifications.
Transaction Status
You can view the status of your transaction by checking the wallet address on the block explorer from which you made the payment.
Processing Time
Cryptocurrency payments can take up to a few hours to process. Please contact VeVe support only if the transaction has taken more than 10 hours.
Gem Transaction
Your purchase transaction can be viewed on your Gem Wallet > Transaction screen
Wyre Payments Inc.
Your cryptocurrency payment is being made to Wyre Payments, Inc who will convert the payment to USD and pay the USD to VeVe as payment for the Gems. The Wyre Inc Terms of Use and Privacy Policy and the VeVe Terms of Use (including refund policy) apply. If you send a different amount of cryptocurrency than the amount indicated in your request, the payment will not be refunded. The number of Gems received will be adjusted to reflect the amount of cryptocurrency actually received.
